verified_facts.text: The hotel sits at the crossroads of the Orchard Road shopping belt, the Singapore Botanic Gardens and the Embassy District.
verified_facts.excerpt: is at the crossroads of the famed Orchard Road shopping belt and the Singapore Botanic Gardens, a World UNESCO Heritage Site, and the Embassy District

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located one block from Orchard Road.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located one block from Orchard Road, our luxury Singapore hotel near the shopping district is primed for those who want to stay close to the retail action.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Singapore officially opened in 2008.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Singapore officially opened in 2008, bringing the Astor family's legacy of hospitality to Southeast Asia.

verified_facts.text: Room interiors use botanical references, with tones of blue and aqua, timber-wood flooring and bespoke furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: The interiors infuse botanical references with modern design, where calming tones of blue and aqua, timber-wood flooring, and bespoke furnishings create a residential atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: Every guest room has a marble bathroom with double vanities, a standing shower and a separate bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every guest room is furnished with a study desk, a 65-inch TV, a marble bathroom with double vanities, a standing shower, a separate bathtub and expansive views of the cityscape.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have potable hot and cold water on tap, a casting-enabled TV and a Bluetooth sound bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: New room features include potable hot and cold water on tap, a casting-enabled TV and a Bluetooth sound bar.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Butler Service is available 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: daily evening champagne sabrage and our 24-hour legendary St. Regis Butler Service

verified_facts.text: Complimentary butler services include packing and unpacking of luggage, beverage service, daily garment pressing and shoe shine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every stay is completed with complimentary butler services including packing and unpacking of your luggage; beverage service upon arrival and in the mornings; daily garment pressing of two pieces daily; shoe shine service

verified_facts.text: A champagne sabrage ritual takes place on the Grand Staircase every evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: Come take part in this revered ritual at the Grand Staircase at 6:30 PM daily.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a private art collection of more than 70 works, including pieces by Pablo Picasso and Marc Chagall and Singaporean artists such as Georgette Chen.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Singapore is home to a distinguished private art collection of more than 70 works of art.

verified_facts.text: The collection includes works by modern masters like Pablo Picasso and Marc Chagall and Asian and Singaporean artists like Georgette Chen, Anthony Poon and Li Chen.
verified_facts.excerpt: from modern masters like Pablo Picasso and Marc Chagall, to acclaimed Asian and Singaporean artists like Georgette Chen, Anthony Poon and Li Chen

verified_facts.text: A complimentary butler-led hotel art tour is offered daily and requires advance reservation.
verified_facts.excerpt: A complimentary butler-led hotel art tour is available on property at 5:30 PM daily. An advanced reservation is required, please approach the Front Desk.

verified_facts.text: On weekends Yan Ting presents an a la carte buffet dim sum brunch.
verified_facts.excerpt: On weekends, Yan Ting presents a captivating a la carte buffet brunch that offers aficionados of Cantonese cuisine a selection of mouth-watering dim sum

verified_facts.text: Sophia, the Italian restaurant, has a dining room inspired by a glasshouse and serves cuisine from 11 regions of Italy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by a glasshouse, Sophia’s captivating, verdant dining room sets the stage for refined Italian favourites.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar is a speakeasy-style cocktail bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: A sophisticated speakeasy cocktail bar near Orchard Road in Singapore where time-honoured drinking rituals are celebrated alongside a curated cocktail menu.

verified_facts.text: The Straits Mary is the hotel's local take on the Bloody Mary, made with bak kwa-infused whisky and chilli padi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our local twist, The Straits Mary is a smoky deconstructed riff featuring bak kwa-infused whisky, chilli padi, and a medley of spices.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea is served daily at The Tea Room, with unlimited scones, artisanal jams and clotted cream.
verified_facts.excerpt: The afternoon tea ritual features unlimited scones, artisanal jams and clotted cream.

verified_facts.text: Tentsuru serves seasonal ingredients flown in from Japan and is led by Chef Daiki Kawaguchi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tentsuru showcases seasonal ingredients air-flown fresh from Japan. Led by Chef Daiki Kawaguchi

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Spa has indoor and outdoor jacuzzis, cedarwood Finnish saunas and eucalyptus steam chambers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our extensive spa facilities include indoor and outdoor jacuzzis, cedarwood Finnish saunas and eucalyptus steam chambers.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool is on level 2 and has a children's pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on level 2, enjoy a refreshing dip in our sparkling pool under blue skies and warm sunshine

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: 24-hour Fitness Centre equipped with state-of-the-art strength and cardio machines, and free weights

verified_facts.text: The Family Traditions program offers children aged 12 and under amenities such as bathrobes, slippers and bath essentials.
verified_facts.excerpt: Especially curated for our younger guests aged 12 and under, the Family Traditions program presents thoughtful amenities such as plush bathrobes, cozy bedroom slippers, and bath essentials

verified_facts.text: Families can have a teepee tent set up in their room for an additional charge.
verified_facts.excerpt: families travelling with children can opt to have a teepee tent set up in their rooms, complete with a galaxy night light for a cozy retreat (additional charges apply)

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: The nearest metro stations are Orchard and Orchard Boulevard, about a 10-minute walk away.
verified_facts.excerpt: The MRT stations (Orchard or Orchard Boulevard) are a 10-minute walk away, making the entire city accessible.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is entirely smoke-free.
verified_facts.excerpt: This is a smoke-free Hotel. Smoking is strictly prohibited on premises.

verified_facts.text: Marina Bay Sands and the waterfront are about 15 minutes away by car.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marina Bay Sands and the waterfront are 15 minutes by car

verified_facts.text: Suites have views of either Orchard Road or the Singapore Botanic Gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: a separate commodious living room overlooking either Orchard Road or the Singapore Botanic Gardens
